resources.string:
Android prevents changing camera or microphone privacy while locked. For this reason, camera and microphone ignore custom lock/unlock delays and trigger immediately.

Microphone can skip this while genuinely in use (a call), if you turn that on below. Camera has no way to detect active use, so it always triggers immediately, even during a video call.

To ensure automatic disabling on lock:

1. Go to Settings → Security → Screen Lock
2. Tap the gear icon ⚙️ next to your lock method
3. Set "Automatically lock" to 5 seconds or more
4. Disable "Power button instantly locks" (if present)

Allows Privacy Flip to detect side/power button locks earlier, enabling camera and microphone privacy features to work with instant-lock. This service does not read screen content or passwords. It detects lock screen appearance to trigger privacy actions before keyguard fully engages, and detects when the lock screen is replaced by another window (a genuine unlock) to cancel privacy actions that are no longer needed.
Enable Accessibility Service for instant-lock support

Allows Privacy Flip to detect side/power button locks before keyguard fully engages, and detects when you unlock again to cancel actions that are no longer needed. Enables camera and microphone privacy even with instant-lock. Does not read screen content.
